items.title: Menneskehandelssak må gjennomføres på nytt etter at forsvarer ble pågrepet
items.excerpt: Da saken var inne i sin sjette uke i Nedre Telemark tingrett, ble en av forsvarerne siktet for bevispåvirkning. Nå er hele rettssaken kansellert.

items.title: Reform UK councillor charged with rape and sexual assault
items.excerpt: The Crown Prosecution Service has charged George Madgwick with 35 offences, including 12 counts of rape.

items.title: Palestinian Americans turn to US flags to protect West Bank homes
items.excerpt: Palestinian Americans in the occupied West Bank are putting up US flags, to fend off pogroms by Israeli settlers.

items.title: UK’s King Charles expresses ‘sorrow’ in Antigua over slave trade
items.excerpt: Caribbean nations call for reparations as King Charles stops short of issuing an apology for colonial-era slavery.

items.title: Kenny's background 'not that important' to O'Neill
items.excerpt: Northern Ireland manager Michael O'Neill says new call-up Eoin Kenny's family connection to the Republic of Ireland is not something he considered before bringing him into the senior squad for this month's Nations League fixtures against Ukraine and Hungary.
